title: The Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025
verified_how: LDH IN/IndiaCode search hit IN_IndiaCode_2025-13 has the title 'The Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025', enactment 2025-04-04 and handle 21918. Its s.1 footnote reads '1st day of September, 2025'.
notes: Replaces the Passport (Entry into India) Act 1920, Registration of Foreigners Act 1939, Foreigners Act 1946 and Immigration (Carriers' Liability) Act 2000 (recalled, not re-read). Visas and employment visas for foreigners are under this Act and its orders and rules.
